{{Top|notoc=1}}
{{Youmay|the astronomical term|the ''Star Wars'' [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]}}
{{Citation}}
{{Quote|Galaxy upon galaxy. Vast, unexplored realms of space. It is a wild, untamed universe we live in.|[[Mungo Baobab]]|<ref name="Treasure">''[[Treasure of the Hidden Planet]]''</ref>}}
A '''galaxy''' was a massive, gravitationally bound assemblage of [[Star/Legends|stars]], an interstellar medium of gas and dust, and an unknown type of dark matter. Typical galaxies contained ten million to one trillion (10<sup>7</sup> to 10<sup>12</sup>) stars, all orbiting a common center of gravity. Galaxies could also contain a large number of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and [[Star cluster/Legends|star clusters]] as well as [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]] and various types of [[Nebula/Legends|nebulae]].

The [[Intergalactic Void]] was the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] between the galaxies.
